concept: West Coast classic hip-hop MTV music video. A crew of performers c-walking and dancing to the beat in the streets of LA (no reference singer — generic West Coast crew). Scenes themed by the lyrics: chrome/lowriders, cornerstones, swap meets, dub plates, concrete West Side legends. Fixed gritty sundown LA look, neon-decay palette, no on-screen text (visuals carry the lyric meaning).
